summary: First-party English and Malayalam discovery identified Kerala's official eMaps/Bhu-Naksha cadastral service, Ente Bhoomi integrated land-information portal, Taliparamba Village Office and Taliparamba resurvey office. eMaps certificate validation failed because the host certificate is expired; Ente Bhoomi loaded but yielded no safe anonymous parcel geometry. No sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, actual URLs, direct requests, TLS outcome, workflow inspection and schema/CRS availability are recorded in city-9447-taliparamba.json. No login, credential, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, TLS bypass or unsafe field request was used.

safeFieldAllowlist: canonical native parcel identifier if independently verified
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [12.0414748876206, 75.3670390105881] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
No exact-point or extent hit/miss was treated as evidence of citywide presence or absence.
No full parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity and geometry response were obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate or title fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The official eMaps host presented an expired TLS certificate; no source-specific exception was authorized, so the viewer's current API/configuration could not be inspected over a trusted connection.
Ente Bhoomi's public workflow confirms land-parcel-map and survey-record services but did not return an anonymous Taliparamba feature response.
Official state/local custodian evidence does not establish complete Taliparamba citywide geometry coverage or stable parcel-identity semantics.
No independent serial reviewer qualification has occurred.
doNotInfer: An expired certificate, timeout, login wall, visual challenge or unusable viewer is not evidence of parcel absence.
A Kerala cadastral service and Taliparamba office listing are not proof of citywide geometry completeness.
A public workflow label is not a returned parcel schema or stable native identifier.
